terminals.name: api
terminals.description: FastAPI app + operator dashboard (http://localhost:8000). Applies migrations, roles and seed data at startup.

terminals.name: worker-public
terminals.command: bash .cursor/svc.sh celery -A scraper.tasks.celery_app worker -Q scraper --concurrency=2 -n scraper-public@%h --loglevel=INFO

terminals.name: worker-maintenance
terminals.command: bash .cursor/svc.sh celery -A scraper.tasks.celery_app worker -Q maintenance --concurrency=2 -n maintenance@%h --loglevel=INFO
terminals.description: Celery worker for maintenance (dispatch, promotion, treatment, archive, reconcile) on its own queue.

terminals.name: worker-scraper
terminals.command: bash .cursor/svc.sh celery -A scraper.tasks.celery_app worker -Q login_session --concurrency=${LOGIN_SESSION_CONCURRENCY:-1} -n scraper-login@%h --loglevel=INFO
terminals.description: Celery worker for the login_session queue (PakistanLawSite); concurrency from LOGIN_SESSION_CONCURRENCY.

terminals.name: worker-embed
terminals.command: bash .cursor/svc.sh celery -A scraper.tasks.celery_app worker -Q embeddings --concurrency=1 -n embed@%h --loglevel=INFO
terminals.description: Celery worker for the embeddings queue.

terminals.name: celery-beat
terminals.description: Celery Beat scheduler (dispatch, promotion, embeddings, archive, treatment).
